# Upscayl

> > Upscayl is a free, open-source AI image upscaler available as a cross-platform desktop application and cloud service, using PyTorch and NCNN frameworks for image enhancement.

Upscayl provides AI-powered image upscaling for Linux, macOS, and Windows through both a desktop application and browser-based cloud service. The project supports batch processing, multiple AI models, and offers comprehensive documentation for setup and troubleshooting.

## Key Topics

- AI image upscaling
- PyTorch
- NCNN
- Cross-platform compatibility
- Upscayl Desktop
- Upscayl Cloud
- Open-source
- Batch processing
- Image enhancement
- GPU requirements
- Model conversion
- Linux/macOS/Windows support
- AppImage
- Cloud service

## Getting Started

- [Upscayl Homepage](https://upscayl.org/): Main landing page for Upscayl AI Image Upscaler with overview of features and platform support
- [Download Upscayl Desktop](https://upscayl.org/download): Download page for Upscayl Desktop application across Linux, macOS, and Windows platforms
- [Introduction & Documentation](https://docs.upscayl.org/): Official documentation covering PyTorch, NCNN frameworks, setup guides, and getting started

## Cloud Service

- [Upscayl Cloud](https://upscayl.org/cloud): Browser-based AI image upscaling and editing service accessible without installation
- [Pricing & Plans](https://upscayl.org/pricing): Subscription options, pricing plans, and credit packages for Upscayl Cloud service
